query: SELECT push_id AS "push_id!: String",retention AS "retention!: String",delivery_state AS "delivery_state!: String",created_at AS "created_at!: String",settled_at FROM router_pushes WHERE (retention='creationAge' AND created_at<?) OR (retention='mailTerminalAge' AND settled_at<?) OR retention NOT IN ('creationAge','mailTerminalAge') ORDER BY CASE WHEN retention='mailTerminalAge' THEN settled_at ELSE created_at END,push_id LIMIT ?
